profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Results-driven software engineer with over a decade of experience in large-scale distributed storage and infrastructure systems. Proven ability to design and operate storage platforms supporting petabyte-scale data, multi-region replication, and zero-downtime migrations.

Recently focused on building AI-driven agentic systems for infrastructure reliability and Kubernetes debugging, MCP servers, and Go-based tooling. Experienced in fault-tolerant design, observability, and performance optimization across complex distributed environments.

positions.title: MTS 2 Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and executed storage-related migrations from bare-metal to managed Kubernetes platforms with zero downtime across POPs and datacenters.

Built an NVMe-accelerated compaction and replica-rebalancing pipeline for zStore, enabling multi-petabyte clusters to complete compaction and placement work in days instead of months. Integrated the accelerated compaction into tech-refresh workflows, eliminating standalone multi-month compaction projects and improving overall cluster reliability.
positions.insights: Fault Tolerant Cluster Deployments, Go (Programming Language) and +11 skills

positions.title: MTS 1 Software Engineer
positions.description:
Operated and evolved zStore, eBay’s 200+ PB blob storage system powering all listing images and videos.

Led multiple zero-downtime hardware refresh cycles, migrating hundreds of petabytes from legacy arrays to commodity hardware, saving $1.9M+.

Automated provisioning, placement, capacity balancing, and lifecycle workflows across thousands of drives and nodes.

Built a high-throughput ML-focused storage cluster using zStore optimized for random read workloads using cheap drives + cache tuning — delivered multi-x faster access for long-term image retention.
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Cluster Lifecycle Automation and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
Designed and tested 10× scale cluster maps using containerized simulations to validate placement, replication, and failure behavior before production rollout.

Eliminated redundant hardware (Ethernet cards, HW RAID, unnecessary components) for next-gen SKUs — significantly cutting per-node costs.
positions.insights: Cluster Lifecycle Automation, Observability and Root Cause Analysis and +6 skills
